QuestInfo.name: [Eluna Express] Time and Space
QuestInfo.0: Eremos can tell you where the next training location is.
QuestInfo.1: Eremos is suddenly so upbeat about life and the universe again that he starts excitedly telling you all about Korean Folk Town. It's a fascinating place where fiction comes alive, and apparently an ideal training location for you. Complete the tasks listed on all of the Most Wanted bulletin boards around Korean Folk Town, then talk to Eremos again.
QuestInfo.2: The training you completed in Korean Folk Town was indeed unique, and Eremos's good mood seems to be rubbing off on you.
QuestInfo.demandSummary: Complete all of the Most Wanted quests in Korean Folk Town
